prompt:
Produce up to 4 distinct, useful design or engineering actions for the task below. Explore materially different mechanisms, including non-obvious alternatives. Respect every constraint. Give executable changes in the target domain, with an implementation step and a falsifiable check. Do not claim unmeasured gains, invent supporting facts, or rename the same action several ways. State actions in the user's terms; omit donor names and analogy explanations from the answer. Fewer actions, including none, are acceptable when no additional valid action remains. Keep each action compact: aim for 60–80 words TOTAL across its five fields, never more than 110. Suggested field budgets: action 8 words, mechanism 16, implementation 22, check 20, risk 10. The 110-word maximum applies to the SUM of all five values, not to each field.

Task:
{
  "title": "Highlights after a document revision",
  "brief": "A reading tool stores highlights and notes in technical documents. When the document is edited, character offsets point to the wrong passages. Some deleted passages remain important to the reader's notes.",
  "constraints": [
    "Keep a copy of the originally highlighted text and its document revision.",
    "Do not silently attach a note to a merely similar passage.",
    "The user can compare old and new passages.",
    "Documents can contain repeated boilerplate and moved sections."
  ],
  "success_criteria": [
    "A moved passage can retain its notes with traceable evidence.",
    "Ambiguous or deleted matches remain explicit.",
    "Test identical repeated sentences, a moved paragraph, and a small meaning-changing edit."
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Rewriting user notes or guaranteeing a match for every highlight."
  ]
}
Optional outside cue:
Donor domain: Theatrical lighting cue tracking
Relation: A sequence can store only changes while unchanged values continue forward. Inserting one change can therefore affect later states until another explicit change overrides it. A local-only edit restores the former value at the next step, while a full state boundary can stop earlier changes propagating farther.
Boundary: Difference records and complete snapshots are not interchangeable. The intended scope of an edit must be explicit; changing one step does not imply every later state should change.
Treat the relation as an optional prompt for exploration. Transfer useful relationships, not surface nouns. The donor is not evidence that a target intervention will work. Ignore the cue if it cannot support a valid move.

Return JSON only: {"actions":[{"action":"...","mechanism":"...","implementation":"...","check":"...","risk":"..."}],"abstention_reason":""}. Use abstention_reason only to explain an empty action list. No tools or additional research.
